title: Donation Alerts
description: A Minecraft plugin for broadcasting grouped store alerts.
body:
# 🎉 Donation Alerts

Donation Alerts is a lightweight **Spigot/Paper plugin** that delivers **polished, grouped donation alerts** in your server chat.  

Instead of spamming multiple messages, purchases made by the same player within a short window are **merged into a single clean alert**, keeping your chat organized and professional.

---

## ✨ Features
- 🔹 **Grouped donation alerts** to reduce chat spam  
- 🔹 **Customizable message format** for full control  
- 🔹 **Optional broadcast sounds** for each alert  
- 🔹 **Run console commands** when alerts trigger  
- 🔹 **Supports PlaceholderAPI**  

---

## 🚀 Usage
Trigger an alert with the command: `/donationalert <player> <item name>`


Configure messages, sounds, and commands in the `config.yml`.

---

Lightweight, modern, and ready to drop into your Minecraft server!
